thread:
joel.sales: Heads-up PacificHealth POC wants a SOC2 excerpt + signed pen-test attestation. They also want ephemeral KMS creds so their external auditor can run a quick scan against staging. Any red flags?
mira.se: We can support ephemeral creds + presigned uploads. Need to confirm egress rules, upload destination (S3 vs SFTP), and whether they require Dedicated single-tenant KMS.
harry.sec: From security side: (1) pen-test attestation template is available but we need the buyers signer name and contact. (2) SOC2 will be provided redacted for internal IPs/service accounts. (3) For Private deployments, ephemeral KMS provisioning requires KMS owner approval and a 1-page runbook.
joel.sales: They want everything by Thursday COB. Can we produce the draft attestation + pointer to SOC2 redacted artifacts by then?
sam.pm: I'll assemble a minimal evidence bundle. Harry, confirm redaction pattern so I can run it by Legal.
harry.sec: Use the standard redaction set: remove internal CIDRs, internal hostnames, and any account email addresses. Ill drop the checklist in the folder. attest-bot: SOC2 excerpt (redacted) uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/soc2/pacifichealth-2026-06-02.zip
mira.se: For ephemeral KMS we need two things from the customer: (a) staging CIDR(s) to allowlist, (b) desired key rotation window and whether they require HSM-backed keys. Also note: Dedicated KMS isolation has a pricing delta.
joel.sales: CIDRs already included in the request. I'll follow up on rotation/HSM preference and signer details. Please add the Dedicated delta to the quote.
mira.se: Ballpark estimate: Dedicated + KMS isolation = +$3,450/month (subject to infra confirmation).
harry.sec: If they insist on independent 3rd-party red-team evidence (instead of our attestation), plan for +~2 weeks to the timeline.
sam.pm: Evidence checklist I'm building: 1) SOC2 redacted excerpt 2) minimal network diagram 3) pen-test attestation draft 4) KMS keyflow diagram 5) presigned upload example 6) ephemeral creds runbook
joel.sales: Can you paste the presign example I can forward to their infra?
mira.se: Presign example:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/pacific-poc.zip --expires-in 3600
```
harry.sec: Security note: keep expiry short (<=1h), enforce single-use tracking, and record request_id in audit logs. Also redact any machine-auth tokens from the bundle.
joel.sales: The customer asked whether the pen-test letter can explicitly mention support for on-prem HSMs. Safe to include?
harry.sec: Allowed wording: "Redwood supports Private deployments with customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations." Do not assert support for specific HSM vendors unless validated.
sam.pm: I'll upload the draft attestation and SOC2 excerpt to the shared folder and loop Legal for quick sign-off. attest-bot: Pen-test-attestation-template_v4.docx uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/templates/pen-test-attestation_v4.docx
joel.sales: Thanks team. I'll bundle and send to PacificHealth and request signer details and rotation preference. Will report back if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
